# QA round

A formal QA round must identify the exact build and environment before execution starts.

## Round manifest

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Commit or tag under test | |
| Deployed image | |
| Target environment | |
| Authorized integrations | |
| Laboratory dataset | |
| QA lab inventory | |
| Round owner | |
| Start and end dates | |

## Scope

- Included test cases:
- Covered requirements:
- Exit criteria:

## Closure checklist

- [ ] Traces and screenshots exported and attached, not only linked.
- [ ] Commit/tag and deployed image recorded above.
- [ ] Traceability matrix updated.
- [ ] Test statuses normalized to the approved taxonomy.
- [ ] Every failure has a linked bug report and owner.
- [ ] Matrix summary recalculated.
